student_use.project: Explore whether broad clothing categories could help organize a simple second-hand clothing catalog, then explain why tiny grayscale benchmark images do not establish real-world performance.
limits: Not photographs of arbitrary clothes taken in everyday settings.
Does not label color, size, garment condition, brand, fit, or reuse suitability.
Predictions must not determine real donation, resale, or disposal decisions without separately collected and evaluated local images.
